//: Type-checks what tsconfig.json cannot. That one is a build config, pinned to rootDir src and emitting declarations, so it can only cover the server tree; vite builds the browser tree without type-checking it at all. web/src stays out: it is the retiring v1 UI, and it reduces a snapshot's events as display events, while protocol/events.ts types that field as the whole TutorialEvent union, and narrowing it is a protocol decision rather than a config one.
